build_resnet_torso: build an IMPALA-style ResNet torso network for processing pixel inputs with configurable channels and blocks
build_drq_torso: build a DrQ convolutional torso network with orthogonal weight initialization for pixel inputs
build_residual_block_group: build a residual block group with downsampling convolutions and max pooling for ResNet layers
test_resnet_torso_forward: test the ResNetTorso forward pass by passing a batch of image tensors through the network
refactor_preprocess_inputs: refactor the preprocess inputs function to support additional input normalization strategies
